description.p: Create, inspect, verify and extract MAME CHD (Compressed Hunks of Data) images without touching the command line.

Every chdman sub-command is available as a guided form: CD, DVD, hard disk, raw and LaserDisc creation, extraction back to cue/bin or ISO, recompression, metadata editing and the built-in HDD template list.

Jobs run in a queue with live progress, compression ratio, per-job logs and structured CHD summaries (hashes, sizes, media type, metadata). A working chdman engine and all of its libraries ship inside the app.

New start screen: choose or drop a file and the app identifies it and recommends the valid operations with pre-filled forms. CHD media is detected from its metadata, ISOs are checked for ISO 9660/UDF, cue sets report their tracks and companion sheets are picked up for raw images. Files can also be opened with the app from the command line or the desktop's Open With action.
Ship the application icon at 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256 and 512 pixels. KDE's Kickoff launcher did not scale a lone 512px icon, so the entry appeared without an icon.

Detect the CHD media type before extraction. Choosing CHD → DVD/ISO for a CD CHD now warns and offers a one-click switch to the correct extractor. CD tracks with 2048-byte sectors can be written directly as a valid .iso.
